result.title: Preserving the Manifold: Frozen Expert Alignment for Label-Efficient SAR Scene Understanding
result.comment: 10 pages. A shorter version of this work was presented at the ECCV 2026 Workshop TerraBytes II: Towards Global Datasets and Models for Earth Observation (non-archival)
result.summary: Cross-modal alignment of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery to natural language is constrained by two distinct failures. The first is modality mismatch: text encoders pre-trained on optical imagery, such as CLIP, cannot be efficiently fine-tuned on SAR, because active microwave backscatter is physically incompatible with passive optical reflectance and the available SAR caption datasets are orders of magnitude too small to bridge this gap without substantially degrading the learned semantic manifold. The second is physical forgetting: SAR encoders pre-trained on large-scale self-supervised objectives encode radar physics that are progressively erased when the encoder is fine-tuned for text alignment on limited caption data. A single design principle addresses both failures: keep both encoders frozen and learn only a constrained, structure-preserving bridge. Our Frozen Expert framework aligns a frozen CROMA SAR encoder with a frozen CLIP text encoder via a lightweight constrained residual bridge. We formally define physical forgetting via Procrustes disparity and show our bridge preserves SAR geometry significantly better than fine-tuning (disparity: 0.210 vs. 0.351). We validate generality across multiple SAR backbones and text encoders. On zero-shot SAR scene classification, our approach outperforms fine-tuned baselines using up to 8x less training data: DFC2020 (+10.3% R@1, +15.5% mAP), EuroSAT-SAR (+15.7% R@1, +12.2% mAP), BigEarthNet-MM (+14.7% R@1). These results establish frozen manifold alignment as a principled, data-efficient alternative to fine-tuning in high-disparity cross-modal settings.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对 SAR 与文本跨模态对齐中的模态失配与「物理遗忘」，提出 Frozen Expert 框架：冻结 CROMA SAR 编码器与 CLIP 文本编码器，只训练轻量约束残差桥，并用 Procrustes disparity 量化表征几何的漂移，在零样本 SAR 场景分类上以更少训练数据超过微调基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「冻结编码器＋结构保持残差桥」及用 Procrustes 差异度量表示几何漂移的诊断方式，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据是否在内部状态被保留、跨模块对齐是否引发信息坍缩，但本身不涉及推理状态生成。
